test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Advanced Full Test - 04
subject: general
question:
Directions: In the following question assuming the given statements to be True, find which of the conclusion among given conclusions is / are definitely true and then give your answers accordingly.

Statements: B B, C > F, F Conclusions:

1) C > N

2) B = F

options.text: Both I and II are True
Neither I nor II is true

solution:
Given statements: B B, C > F, F B F C > N → False (as C > F → thus clear relation between C and N cannot be determined)

2) B = F → False (as B F → thus clear relation between B and F cannot be determined)

Hence, "**Neither I nor II is true"** is true.
